todayEvents.title: Rose Bowl Flea Market
todayEvents.note: The famous monthly flea market returns to the Rose Bowl with hundreds of vendors selling vintage goods, antiques, and collectibles.

todayEvents.title: Fall Brewery Artwalk
todayEvents.note: More than 100 resident artists open their working studios at the historic Brewery Arts Complex, with free parking onsite.

todayEvents.title: LA NDN Flea
todayEvents.note: The Broad hosts this Indigenous makers' market with The Chapter House, celebrating Native American History Month with handcrafted goods, DJ sets, and food vendors.

todayEvents.title: Free Second Sunday: Celebrating Himalayan Art & Culture
todayEvents.note: The USC Pacific Asia Museum offers free admission with a sand mandala ceremony, butter sculpture workshops, storytelling, and tea tastings.

todayEvents.title: Renegade Craft Fair
todayEvents.venue: Santa Monica Airport Interim Open Space
todayEvents.note: The Renegade Craft Fair closes its Santa Monica weekend with independent makers selling handmade goods at the Santa Monica Airport open space.

events.title: Camp Flog Gnaw Carnival 2026
events.note: Tyler, the Creator's two-day festival opens at Dodger Stadium with Turnstile, Steve Lacy, Future, and Don Toliver, plus carnival rides.

events.title: East LA Youth Mariachi Festival
events.note: The free third annual festival showcases young mariachi bands, Mexican culture, and a mercado at the East LA Civic Center.

events.title: Jorja Smith
events.note: Jorja Smith opens her five-city North American tour at the Orpheum Theatre in Downtown Los Angeles, her only Southern California date.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame Induction Ceremony 2026
events.note: The 2026 induction ceremony tapes at the Peacock Theater, honoring inductees including Phil Collins, Oasis, and Sade.

events.title: CicLAvia—Pasadena
events.note: CicLAvia opens 2.7 miles of car-free streets along Colorado Boulevard and Raymond Avenue for biking, walking, and skating.

events.title: The Who's Tommy
events.note: The Tony-nominated revival of The Who's Tommy plays its closing-day performances at the Hollywood Pantages Theatre.

events.title: Usher & Chris Brown: The R&B Tour
events.note: Usher and Chris Brown bring their joint R&B Tour to SoFi Stadium, with Mario, Tank, and Eric Bellinger also performing.
